title: P vs. NP and the Computational Complexity Zoo
summary: An 11-minute animated introduction to P vs. NP and the wider landscape of complexity classes, inspired by the Complexity Zoo wiki. It assumes no background in computer science.
why: HN repeatedly recommends it as the best short, funny introduction to P vs. NP and complexity classes for people with no background.

quote.text: This 10 minute video is a great introduction to the P = NP problem and computational complexity theory if you have no context.
